headline: Foxconn and OpenAI Collaborate on AI Hardware as Executives Dismiss Bubble
summary: Foxconn is working on a new partnership with OpenAI focused on AI hardware such as data-centre components, while executives stated there is no artificial intelligence bubble.
why: Hardware manufacturing partnerships for artificial intelligence infrastructure highlight ongoing capital expenditures and supply chain developments for data centers.
